reaches_vs_upside_ge1.explanation: explosion_reaches_plus_100pct is magnitude from explosion onset (peak/onset_price − 1 ≥ 1.0). remaining_upside_to_explosion_peak is peak/reference_price_at_T − 1, i.e. from observation time T. When T is after some of the run-up, upside-from-T can be < 1 while onset-magnitude still ≥ 100%, and vice versa if reference_price differs from onset_price — so ~20% disagreement is expected.

diagnosis.root_cause: Phase-6 filled remaining_upside from training_cache_v1, where the column is ~97% null on explosion_300s positives (many mint partitions entirely null). Positives with null upside were excluded, leaving only ~269. Broad observation_targets has upside defined whenever price_target_available=True and explosion_reaches_plus_100pct on the order of thousands.
